title: In onResult of AccountManagerService.java, there is a possible untrusted/misleading UI issue due to a… (CVE-2026-49923)
description: CVE-2026-49923 is a high-severity vulnerability in the onResult method of AccountManagerService.java caused by a logic error that results in a possible untrusted or misleading UI. This flaw allows local privilege escalation without requiring user interaction or additional execution privileges.
